content: Telegram Bot API rate limits: ~30 messages/second across different chats, ~20 messages/minute to same channel. 429 errors include retry_after parameter. Do not add artificial delays - handle 429s reactively. Use token-bucket rate limiting per scope. Self-hosting local Bot API server raises file upload cap to 2GB but doesn't raise message caps. Paid broadcasts allow 1000 msg/sec with 10K+ Stars balance.
